columns.name: phase_deg
columns.definition: departure phase theta, counterclockwise from +x (Earth->Moon)

columns.name: delta_v_km_s
columns.definition: TLI impulse magnitude

columns.name: impulse_angle_deg
columns.definition: impulse angle alpha from local horizontal (+: outward)

columns.name: outcome
columns.definition: feasibility verdict: 'feasible' or the failure reason

columns.name: termination
columns.definition: propagation termination reason

columns.name: t_final_days
columns.definition: time of the last propagated state after TLI

columns.name: perilune_altitude_km
columns.definition: altitude of the closest Moon periapsis before the return shell crossing (or before t_final without a return); null if none

columns.name: lunar_encounter_time_days
columns.definition: time of that closest Moon periapsis

columns.name: lunar_passage_sense
columns.definition: sign of the rotating-frame Moon-relative angular momentum at perilune (0: none)

columns.name: moon_periapses_in_band
columns.definition: Moon periapses in the perilune band before return

columns.name: earth_periapses_after_encounter
columns.definition: Earth periapses between the closest lunar approach and the return (or t_final)

columns.name: return_time_days
columns.definition: inbound return-shell crossing time; null if none

columns.name: return_speed_km_s
columns.definition: Earth-relative inertial speed at the return shell

columns.name: return_flight_path_angle_deg
columns.definition: Earth-relative inertial flight-path angle at the return shell (< 0: descending)

columns.name: return_vacuum_perigee_altitude_km
columns.definition: osculating two-body (Earth only, no atmosphere) perigee altitude at the return-shell crossing; null without a return

columns.name: vacuum_perigee_altitude_km
columns.definition: targeting value: osculating vacuum perigee altitude at the first Earth approach after the closest lunar approach (the shell crossing if no Earth periapsis precedes it, else the first post-lunar Earth periapsis); null if neither

columns.name: perigee_source
columns.definition: 'return_shell', 'earth_periapsis' or 'none'

columns.name: jacobi_constant
columns.definition: Jacobi constant of the initial state

columns.name: jacobi_max_abs_drift_steps
columns.definition: max |C(s_i) - C(s_0)| over the accepted solver steps

columns.name: nfev
columns.definition: right-hand-side evaluations of the propagation
